svg.title: ARMOR-NODE-ELECTRICAL architecture
svg.desc: The firmware of ARMOR-NODE-ELECTRICAL asks up to 16 PZEM meters over one serial line, publishes what they read with its age, and holds the rules for switching contactors: an interlock that never closes two sources together, orders in two steps and a fault that stays until it is acknowledged. Nothing here switches anything today and nothing has run on a board.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Measures the installation with PZEM meters and holds the interlock for a transfer between two sources; switching is off by default.
